onboarding.title: Set up your restaurant
onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: A few simple steps and your restaurant will be ready to operate. Only the essentials below are required — everything else can wait.
onboarding.languageSubtitle: You can change this later at any time from Settings.
onboarding.mandatorySubtitle: Required for valid tax invoices — collected once, and can't be skipped.
onboarding.restaurantNameHint: The trade name shown to your customers.
onboarding.restaurantNameEnHint: Shown when a customer picks English.
onboarding.typeHint: Helps us tailor the experience to your business.
onboarding.vatNumberHint: 15 digits, usually starting and ending with 3 — mandatory on every invoice.
onboarding.crNumberHint: The CR number issued by the Ministry of Commerce.
onboarding.addressHint: The main street name of the restaurant's location.
onboarding.districtHint: The district name per the National Address.
onboarding.buildingNumberHint: 4 digits per the Saudi National Address standard (required on invoices).
onboarding.postalCodeHint: 5 digits per the Saudi National Address standard.
onboarding.additionalAddressHint: Any extra detail that helps pinpoint the location (unit number, floor, landmark...).
onboarding.contactPhoneHint: The restaurant management's main contact number.
onboarding.branchNameHint: A name that distinguishes this branch from any future ones.
onboarding.branchAddressHint: The branch's address as shown to customers (optional for now).
onboarding.branchEmailHint: An email address specific to this branch, if any.
onboarding.hubTitle: Nicely done! Just optional settings remain
onboarding.hubSubtitle: Your restaurant is ready to operate now. The items below improve your experience — finish them or skip for later; anything skipped shows up as a dashboard reminder.
onboarding.cardLogoDesc: Shown on the dashboard, invoices, and the ordering page.
onboarding.cardReceiptDesc: A note printed above and below the receipt.
onboarding.cardThemeDesc: Pick a color for your dashboard's interface.
onboarding.cardZatcaDesc: Phase 1 already works automatically; enable Phase 2 only if your restaurant is required to.
onboarding.cardStaffDesc: Add a cashier and kitchen account for your team.
onboarding.cardMenuDesc: Add your first menu category and product.
onboarding.cardTablesDesc: Add more branches, tables, and QR codes.
onboarding.logoStepSubtitle: Optional — you can upload it later from Settings any time.
onboarding.receiptStepSubtitle: Text shown above and below every printed receipt — a thank-you note or a return policy, for instance.
onboarding.receiptHeaderNoteHint: e.g. "We hope you enjoy your meal".
onboarding.themeStepSubtitle: Pick a color for your own dashboard's interface.
onboarding.zatcaStepSubtitle: Most restaurants start on Phase 1 (already working automatically). Only enable Phase 2 if ZATCA actually requires it for your restaurant yet — you can finish the digital certificate details later from Settings.
onboarding.menuStepSubtitle: A quick start for your menu — add the rest later from the Menu page.
onboarding.menuProductNameHint: The item's name as shown to customers.
onboarding.staffHint: Add your branch manager and cashier now, or skip and add them later.
onboarding.staffKitchenHint: Create a separate "kitchen" account for whoever will run the kitchen display (KDS) — without it, they won't get live order updates.
onboarding.completeSubtitle: Your restaurant is configured — enter the dashboard and get going.
onboarding.receiptTemplateHint: How the printed receipt looks — this only affects new receipts from now on, not ones already printed.
onboarding.receiptLogoPositionHint: Where your logo appears at the top of the printed receipt.
onboarding.receiptLogoSizeHint: How big the logo prints on the receipt.

settings.title: Settings
settings.zatcaHint: Shown on tax invoices and their QR code
settings.publicLinksHint: Public restaurant link for branch pickup orders
settings.qrLinksHint: Per-table QR codes are managed from the Tables page
settings.zatcaPhase2Hint: Only turn this on once your restaurant's revenue actually requires it — Phase 1's QR invoice keeps working perfectly well either way.
settings.zatcaCredentialsHint: From ZATCA's Fatoora portal onboarding. Leave a field blank to keep its current value — nothing here is ever shown back to you once saved.
settings.zatcaConfigured: Fully configured — ready to sign and submit invoices
settings.zatcaNotConfigured: Credentials incomplete — invoices will keep using Phase 1 only until all four are provided
settings.menuDesignHint: How your public online menu looks to customers (the page opened from a table QR code or your pickup link).
settings.menuDesignCustomDescription: Write your own CSS instead of a ready template — for a developer you hire, or if you know CSS yourself.
settings.menuDesignCssHint: Runs only on your menu page, never anywhere else. For safety, it is checked automatically before saving: url(...), @-rules (like @import), and a few other risky bits are rejected — you will see exactly what to fix if something is not allowed.

integrations.title: Integrations & add-ons
integrations.subtitle: Connect delivery platforms, an online payment gateway, an NFC card terminal, and WhatsApp — each one plugs into your real orders, invoices and reports, never a separate side system.
integrations.deliveryHint: Orders arrive automatically and flow through the exact same order pipeline as your POS — stock deduction, KDS, reports and refunds all apply.
integrations.deliveryStoreIdHint: The store/branch identifier the platform itself uses for you.
integrations.deliveryWebhookSecretHint: The secret the platform uses to sign webhook requests — ask their integration team for it.
integrations.deliveryWebhookUrlLabel: Webhook URL to give the platform
integrations.deliveryWebhookUrlHint: Save the connection first, then copy this URL into the platform's own integration settings.
integrations.deliveryMappingsHint: Match each of your products to its ID on the delivery platform, so an incoming order can find the right item. Save the connection first.
integrations.gatewayHint: Lets customers pay online when ordering from your digital menu — recorded as a real sale, same as any other payment. A failed or skipped payment falls back to pay on pickup automatically.
integrations.gatewayWebhookUrlLabel: Webhook URL to give the gateway
integrations.gatewayComingSoon: Checkout for this gateway isn't available yet in this build — choose Moyasar or Tap for now.
integrations.nfcHint: A successful tap-to-pay charge is recorded as a card payment on the same invoice — separate from cash in shift reconciliation.
integrations.nfcStructureNotice: Structure only for now: connecting a real terminal needs a certified partnership with the provider and a native tablet app using their SDK — this saves your settings ahead of that, it does not yet talk to a physical terminal.
integrations.whatsappHint: Sends order and invoice updates to customers automatically, using Meta's WhatsApp Business API directly.
integrations.whatsappTemplatesHint: WhatsApp requires every template below to be approved in your own Meta Business Manager before it can actually send — copy the suggested wording there first. You can lightly edit the wording here before submitting it for approval.
integrations.whatsappTemplateCustomBody: Your wording (optional — before submitting for approval)
integrations.whatsappTemplateMetaName: Exact template name in Meta Business Manager

loyalty.title: Loyalty program
loyalty.subtitle: Enable one or more reward modes — every earn/redeem is a real discount or a real free item on the customer's actual invoice, identified by phone number only.
